rows.label: tlk43310148_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Who forced open the Holy Gate
of Fontana?!

rows.label: tlk43310148_02_msg0002
rows.name:
As you can see, this gate is huge and
built to withstand even Blade attacks.

rows.label: tlk43310148_02_msg0003
rows.name:
It was built to keep the Cloud Sea out
when Invidia's Divine Beast dives...

rows.label: tlk43310148_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But if it was forced open...
Just what kind of special power
did that person have?
